text:
311 catalogued artifacts. 42 researchers and volunteers. One director: Prof. Ansel Okafor, who led the excavation at Tel Maridun.

The dig's final season closed on 14 October 2019. The *Tel Maridun Final Excavation Report* (Maridun Antiquities Authority, Publication No. 27) was presented at the 2020 Eastern Levant Archaeology Symposium.

Dr. Liora Venkataraman, senior ceramicist and deputy field director, confirmed Prof. Okafor's leadership of the project.

The report puts the total at 311 catalogued items, all uncovered by the 42-strong team.

**What it means for the sector:** A published, authority-backed final report settles questions of attribution. It also gives museums, funders and researchers a single reference for the site's assemblage. For anyone citing Tel Maridun, Publication No. 27 is now the document to use.
